verdict.rationale: Motion documents several of its own background behaviors that run without user action. It automatically reshuffles schedules, re-blocks time for recurring daily/weekly/monthly tasks, advances projects when blocking tasks complete, turns forwarded emails into scheduled tasks, and offers an AI Workflow Builder that builds workflows from SOPs. However, user-configurable trigger/action automations are only thinly evidenced, and Zapier connectivity is a third-party route rather than Motion's own automation engine. Missing for 10: documented user-defined automation rules (triggers, conditions, actions), detail on how the AI Workflow Builder's workflows execute autonomously, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically builds workflows based on SOPs
